located_in.description: Textual containment/location; not equivalence or modern coordinates.

planted.description: Narrated planting of the named garden or plant; not independent historical verification.

flows_from.description: River subject flows out of textual place object.

waters.description: River subject supplies water to garden/place object in narrative.

branch_of.description: Named river subject is one of the rivers sourced by the divided river object in the textual account; no modern hydrological reconstruction.

flows_in_front_of.description: River relative to named land using the supplied WEB phrase; not flow through or a modern cardinal bearing.

kingdom_includes.description: Place object explicitly listed in subject’s kingdom; does not assert a modern title.

camped_west_of.description: Person’s narrated tent location west of place object; not residence within the place.

chose_region.description: Narrated selection of the region object; does not establish land ownership.

named_as_prospective_heir.description: Speaker subject identifies object as anticipated heir; attributed speech required and not actual inheritance.

destroyed.description: Destruction narrated of a place/object; no claim beyond the text.

pronounced_blessing_on.description: Speaker subject utters blessing over person object, not a fulfillment/status claim.

gave_tenth_to.description: Narrated transfer of a tenth to recipient; no universal obligation inferred.

paid.description: Payer subject transfers the payment to recipient object; amount/property retained in evidence and note.

sold_to.description: Seller subject transfers property for payment to buyer object in cited transaction; object is buyer, not property.

on_route_to.description: Location subject explicitly or contextually on the way to place object; not a reconstructed modern route.

participated_in_campaign_at.description: Subject participates in the stated military campaign at place object; does not individually attribute every collective action.

military_victory_over.description: Narrated military leader subject returns victorious over opponent object with respective forces; not personal killing.

military_opponent_of.description: Named rulers in explicitly opposing military coalitions; not a personal duel or separate bilateral war.

prohibited_eating_from.description: Speaker subject prohibits eating from named object in attributed command; addressee and scope in evidence/note.

placed_guards_for.description: Subject arranges guards for access to object/place; not necessarily personally guarding.

friend_of.description: Explicitly named friendship, stored once; not inferred from proximity.

priest_of.description: Person serving as priest of the named place; no identification of the worshipped deity is implied.

named.description: Narrated naming of a place or object; the assigned name is in entity aliases and evidence. Does not imply sole construction.

camped_at.description: Temporary encampment at the cited textual place, including explicit group participation.

crossed.description: Narrated crossing of a named watercourse/ford; no modern route reconstructed.

waited_at.description: Person sits/waits at named place; not permanent residence or an occupation.

buried_on_way_to.description: Route-relative burial; explicitly not burial inside the destination town.

sent_messengers_to.description: Sender dispatches messengers toward named location; does not establish sender arrival.

nurse_of.description: Explicit nurse/household-care role; does not infer biological motherhood.
